name.en: Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin)
name.hi: विकसित भारत - रोजगार और आजीविका मिशन (ग्रामीण)

description.en: Rural wage-employment guarantee framework under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025.

application.channel: Gram Panchayat / designated local implementing authority under the state-notified VB-G RAM G Scheme
application.instructions: The Act is in force from 2026-07-01. State schemes and operational procedures apply; confirm the state notification, job-card process and local authority.

grievance.instructions: Submit complaints at the Gram Panchayat, Block or District level regarding employment, job cards or wage payments. Keep the complaint acknowledgement. If the issue is not resolved, escalate it to the next higher authority or approach the District Ombudsperson.

sources.title: VB-G RAM G implementation and commencement
sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Rural Development
sources.supports: Commenced nationwide in rural areas from 2026-07-01

sources.title: VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 FAQs
sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Rural Development
sources.supports: 125-day guarantee and repeal of MGNREGA from 2026-07-01

verification.warning: A scheme-level status does not establish an individual's eligibility. Confirm the current state/UT implementation and official beneficiary record.

notes: As of 2026-07-01, VB-G RAM G replaced MGNREGA; do not label this file as MGNREGA.
Wage rates are state-specific and notification-dependent; do not hard-code a single national wage amount.
The Act guarantees 125 days per rural household, not per individual worker.
Check the latest final rules and Rajasthan/UP state scheme notifications before implementing procedural rules.
